name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 22 times in 7 visits over 52 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 46 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.2 days starting 2025-11-28, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.29 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
